ChangeAspectBeforeAfterImpact
✏️ Modified API-version availability The service surface is available only as 2025-05-01-preview. The same 35-operation surface is also available as stable 2026-06-01.
The stable version retains the replaced preview version
✏️ Modified generated client API-version default Generated clients default to 2025-05-01-preview. Generated clients default to 2026-06-01.
The stable version retains the replaced preview version
✏️ Modified Go Monitors_Delete parameter order The stable generation would use the default TypeSpec parameter order. A Go-scoped override preserves the released apiVersion, subscriptionId, resourceGroupName, provider, userEmail, monitorName order.
The stable version retains the replaced preview version
